document.abstract: Flight has always been a popular subject for motion picture and television productions. A new system called “Scene-Sync” enables cameras to pan through an arc of up to 90 degrees, while making use of the technique of chromakey. This makes it possible to economically re-create many aerial shots in the studio - instead of having to use conventional means.
